title: Attempt Event v1
description: Frozen execution contract (SW-1510-CONTRACT). One append-only journal event for a run/task/attempt, measured by the process/gateway collector. event_id is a host correlation key, treated as a collected fact, not a worker assertion. issuer and principal must name an authenticated authority; the schema can express but cannot enforce that, so consumers treat unauthenticated issuers as untrusted input.

event_id.description: Host-observed correlation key (for example a gateway request id). Not a model-authored claim.

sequence.description: Monotonic per-run event sequence. Gaps or duplicates are contention, not silently renumbered events.

issuer.description: Authenticated issuer. Passing the schema is not authentication.
